title: Hearty Fresh Malaysian Oxtail Braise
description: A Buddhist-temple-friendly dish that is perfect for a weekday dinner. This oxtail braise is a glassy-jelly energizer that is easy to prepare and delicious to eat.

ingredients.name: 1 onion
ingredients.notes: use brown onion for a sweeter flavor

ingredients.name: 2 inches ginger
ingredients.notes: use a microplane for best results

ingredients.name: salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: use a pinch of salt and a few grinds of pepper

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the oxtail and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, coconut water, tamarind paste, brown sugar, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to a preheated oven at 300°F.
Braise for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for another minute.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
